body:
Source: GitHub issues #643 (bug, security, P1-high) and #644 (bug, P1-high), both in packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/record.mjs. Re-verified on main @ de8a130a. (a) record.mjs:25-26 take `id = defeat.id ?? …` and `target = defeat.target` straight from the model's candidate (loop.mjs:185 spreads the candidate into the defeat), then :43 `join(defeatsDir, `${id}.json`)` and :51 `join(targetTestDir, `bypass-${id}.test.mjs`)` write with no normalization, basename or containment check, on the HOST (bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs:310 calls `recordDefeats(loopResult.defeats, process.cwd())`). Repro: `writeReproArtifact({ id: '../../../../pwned', target: 'rails-guard', … }, repo)` wrote `<four levels up>/pwned.json` and `<repo>/packages/pwned.test.mjs`, overwriting any existing file (writeFileSync, no exclusive flag). (b) record.mjs:83, inside `buildRedTestScaffold`'s emitted source: `import { join, tmpdir } from 'node:path';` — node:path has no `tmpdir` export, so the generated `packages/<target>/test/bypass-<id>.test.mjs` throws `SyntaxError: The requested module 'node:path' does not provide an export named 'tmpdir'` at instantiation and breaks the target package's `node --test test/*.test.mjs`. test/record.test.mjs only asserts the files exist and never loads the scaffold.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/gate-fuzzing`: bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs (CLI; `--record` branch at :307-312), lib/record.mjs (writeReproArtifact, buildRedTestScaffold, appendFinding, recordDefeats), lib/loop.mjs (builds each defeat as `{ ...candidate, verdict, hash }` where `hash = normalizeAndHash({ target, claimKind, diff })` — a HARNESS-computed sha hex string, already used for dedup), lib/candidate.mjs (validateCandidate — shape only), lib/sandbox.mjs, lib/verdict.mjs, lib/witness.mjs, lib/oracle.mjs. Tests: `npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing` from the worktree root. test/record.test.mjs is NOT a rail: its first case asserts the artifact lands at `.adlc/gate-defeats/test-id.json` from a model-supplied `id`, which pins defect (a) — rewrite it against the new naming and say so in the PR body. appendFinding (record.mjs:106-130) writes `file: packages/${defeat.target}/bin/${defeat.target}.mjs` into findings.jsonl — it is a string field, not a path write, and stays as is except that it must use the validated target.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Artifact naming is harness-derived. ONE exported pure function in lib/record.mjs, `artifactId(defeat)`, returns the first 16 hex characters of `defeat.hash` when `hash` is a non-empty string matching /^[0-9a-f]+$/i, else `cand-<Date.now()>`. `defeat.id` is never read for any path or filename; it may still be echoed inside the JSON artifact under a `candidateId` field for traceability.
2. ONE exported pure validator in lib/record.mjs, `isSafeTarget(value)`: true only for a string matching /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$/ that is not `.` and not `..`. When `isSafeTarget(defeat.target)` is false the repro JSON is still written under `.adlc/gate-defeats/<artifactId>.json`, the test scaffold is NOT written, and ONE stderr line `gate-fuzzing: refusing to write a test scaffold for unsafe target <JSON.stringify(target)>` is printed. recordDefeats keeps going for the remaining defeats; exit code unchanged.
3. Containment is asserted, not assumed: before each writeFileSync, the resolved path must satisfy `resolve(path).startsWith(resolve(baseDir) + sep)` for its base (`.adlc/gate-defeats` or `packages/<target>/test`); a violation throws an Error whose message starts with `gate-fuzzing: refusing to write outside` (defence in depth behind rules 1 and 2; the CLI's existing operational-error handling turns an uncaught Error into exit 1).
4. The emitted scaffold imports only what it uses: `import { test } from 'node:test';` and nothing else unless the emitted body uses it (today the body uses only `t.todo`). No `node:path` `tmpdir` import. The scaffold must be loadable as an ES module and runnable with `node --test`, reporting one todo and zero failures.
5. Regression guards: the JSON artifact still carries id, target, claimKind, strategy, ts, diff, setup, witness, witnessSource, redTestScaffold; the scaffold file still lands at `packages/<target>/test/bypass-<artifactId>.test.mjs` for a safe target; the dry-run default (no `--record`) still writes nothing. The findings.jsonl append keeps its entry shape (ts, tool, file, line, category, severity, desc, verdict, witnessSource), but its `desc` names the artifact id and the `.adlc/gate-defeats` directory as SEPARATE tokens and never embeds the repro path: the committed findings ledger refuses any token of 32+ characters with mixed letters and digits and entropy >= 4 bits/char (packages/core/lib/ledger.mjs assertPublishableFinding, ADR 0014), and the previous `Repro artifact at <absolute path>` desc tripped that rule on every real --record run. For an unsafe target `file` is `.adlc/gate-defeats` (no package directory exists for it); for a safe target it stays `packages/<target>/bin/<target>.mjs`.
6. Documentation: `packages/gate-fuzzing/README.md` (the paragraph at ~line 132 naming `.adlc/gate-defeats/<id>.json`) and by hand `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/gate-fuzzing.mdx` (the `--record` row at ~line 43): say the artifact id is derived from the defeat's content hash, never from model output, and that the scaffold is only written for a target name matching the allowed pattern. Never regenerate the mdx.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A defeat with `id: '../../../../pwned'` and a valid hash writes only `.adlc/gate-defeats/<16-hex>.json` and `packages/<target>/test/bypass-<16-hex>.test.mjs`; nothing exists above the fixture root and no file named pwned exists anywhere under it. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/record-paths.test.mjs`
- AC2 A defeat with `target: '../..'` (and separately `target: 'a/b'`) writes the repro JSON, writes NO scaffold, prints the stderr refusal line, and the remaining defeats in the same recordDefeats call are still recorded. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/record-paths.test.mjs`
- AC3 `isSafeTarget` rejects '', '.', '..', 'a/b', 'a\\b', a 65-char name, and accepts 'rails-guard', 'gate_manifest', 'v1.2'; `artifactId` returns the 16-hex prefix of hash and a `cand-` id when hash is absent. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/record-paths.test.mjs`
- AC4 The written scaffold loads: dynamic `import()` of the written file resolves without throwing, AND `spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', scaffoldPath])` exits 0 with its output reporting `todo 1` and `fail 0`. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/record-paths.test.mjs`
- AC5 Containment guard fires: calling the write path with a crafted base/path pair that escapes throws an Error starting with `gate-fuzzing: refusing to write outside`. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/record-paths.test.mjs`
- AC6 Existing suite green with test/record.test.mjs rewritten to the hash-derived naming. verify: `npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing`
- AC7 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "content hash" packages/gate-fuzzing/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/gate-fuzzing.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC8 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: #642 (witnessSource independence), #647 (gates without surface/claims), #650 (documenting the scaffold write as a repo mutation beyond the two doc edits above), lib/loop.mjs, lib/sandbox.mjs, the SBPL escaping in #649.
title: gate-fuzzing: derive --record artifact paths from harness state and emit a loadable RED scaffold
